title: Plus Size Deep V-Neck Chiffon Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Chic and easy to wear, this plus size evening dress highlights the neckline and collarbone with its soft V-neck. The fitted bodice helps shape the waist, while the high low skirt adds light movement and a graceful finish through the legs. A lovely choice for weddings, evening parties, and other special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: High low.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
